protection: No new probe when P has no HTTP work. E accepts only with no pending E HTTP request. D accepts only with zero active or pending D HTTP admission. Native D waits until actual probe completion.
nonpreemption: A new Encode arrival can wait for an already launched helper kernel. Stream priority is not preemption.
relative_gates: Paired N3 Encoder HTTP service p95, ITLp99 and TPOTp95 CI upper<=1.05. Absolute Decode attainment>=95%.
end_to_end_protection: Also report TTFTp50/p95 NI and SLO-goodput against each Native control. Encoder HTTP completion is not guaranteed GPU completion. Do not call it exclusive encoder service.
observer: OFF during timing. HTTP service enclosure includes queue and host cost, not GPU-exclusive time.
evidence_limit: Qualified low-load idle does not prove QPS2 safe headroom. This experiment tests conservative current-state probes empirically. No future window is assumed. Main100 is not yet confirmed prefill-heavy.
exclusions: No imported prefix KV, suffix continuation,3way partition, actual Main task completion by probes, maximum encoder-batch claim or sustainable-capacity claim.
quality: PENDING. No external task-answer extraction without approval.
